FULL TEXT:
DR. S.S . BHATNAGAR UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF CHEMICAL ENGINEERING &
TECHNOLOGY, PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
WALK-IN-INTERVIEW
No.Dr.SSBUICET/26/_262_
Dated:07.09.2026
The Walk-in-Interviews for appointing Guest Faculty for Chemical Engineering for the period from
July to December 2026 (Odd Semester) will be held on 17.09.2026 in the Dr. S.S. Bhatnagar
University Institute of Chemical Engineering & Technology, Panjab University, Chandigarh,
as per schedule given below:
Dated: 17.09.2026
Subject Time
Documents Verifications Chemical Engineering 11.30 am to 01.00 pm
INTERVIEWS
Dated 17.09.2026 Chemical Engineering 02.00 pm
Qualifications:
Assistant Professor in
Chemical Engineering :
(02)
B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or Integrated M.Tech in
Chemical Engineering with first class or equivalent in any one of the
degrees.
All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant documents for
verification along with the duly filled form giving the details at the time of interview. The application
form for the post of Assistant Professor (Page 1 to 9) is available at website
http://jobs.puchd.ac.in/forms.php and the same is to be submitted to the office staff of the Institute
at the venue on the date of the interview.
The above assignment is on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs.1500/- per lecture with an
upper limit of Rs.50000/- per month as per University rule.
(Prof. Anupama Thakur)
Chairperson
